name: Patel Infinity Widgets for Elementor
author: Dharmik Patel

sections.description:
Patel Infinity Widgets adds creative widgets, product filters, interactive elements, layouts, and WooCommerce enhancements for Elementor websites.

Live Demo: View Live Demo

Features:

  • Pi Product Filter widget title
  • Product Category Filter
  • Brand Filter
  • Size Filter
  • Availability Filter
  • Price Min/Max section inside Pi Product Filter
  • Range slider
  • Min/Max price inputs
  • Currency symbol control
  • Price step control
  • Auto price detection from WooCommerce product prices
  • Product query filtering by price
  • Product Sorting
  • Product Result Count
  • Multiple Filter Selection
  • Dynamic Filtering
  • Responsive Controls
sections.installation:
1. Upload and activate the Elementor plugin.
  2. Upload and activate the Patel Infinity Widgets for Elementor plugin.
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and activated if you plan to use WooCommerce widgets and filters.
  4. Open any page or template with the Elementor editor.
  5. Search for the Pi widgets in the Elementor widget panel.
  6. Drag and drop the required widget onto your page.
  7. Configure the widget settings and publish or update the page.
sections.changelog:
1.1.2

  • Added Pi Marquee Text widget.
  • Improved Price Min/Max filter UI.
  • Performance improvements.
  • Minor bug fixes.

1.1.1

  • Added cache support for automatic price range detection.
  • Added WordPress.org Plugin Check-safe inline documentation for required WooCommerce price queries.
  • Improved compatibility when WooCommerce is not installed or inactive.
  • Hotfix: Prevent fatal error when WooCommerce is not installed or inactive.

1.1.0

  • Renamed Product Filter widget title to Pi Product Filter.
  • Added Price Filter section inside Pi Product Filter only; no new widget added.
  • Added auto detected min/max WooCommerce product prices.
  • Added range slider, min/max inputs, currency symbol, and step control.
  • Added product query filtering by pi_min_price and pi_max_price.
  • Updated Clear All and result count support for price filters.

1.0.0

  • Initial release
